title: Fault Night
text: A shift in the maintenance control centre of the district around Bf Neustadt, alone: faults come in by their report paths, two emergency teams are on shift and a technician is on call. Rank the faults, send the teams, and ask the signaller for a closure before anybody works in the track.
debrief: Which fault did you send a team to first, and why? What did the faults that waited cost?
A team stood at the signal and the work was in track G2. Who may close a track, and what could have happened without the closure?
Was the technician on call worth the four hours of overtime?
